author: rodzzz
quote:
1/10 – The most anticipated disappointment in gaming history.

After all these years of waiting, Rockstar has delivered what might be the most expensive delay in gaming history. Pretty graphics, endless marketing, and a fanbase willing to sell a kidney just to play it. Innovation? We’ll see. Absurdly overinflated expectations? Absolutely. At this rate, by the time GTA 6 comes out, we’ll need a new console, a second mortgage, and a week off work just to install it. What a joke. I’d rather keep playing GTA V until GTA 7 comes out.

author: rodzzz
quote: The Ocarina of Time Remake is a breathtaking restoration that perfectly balances nostalgia with modern gameplay updates. Featuring lush, revamped visuals, fluid combat, and much-needed quality-of-life improvements—like a frictionless inventory system—it enhances the original masterpiece without losing its foundational soul.Elevated by a sweeping, fully orchestrated soundtrack, the game beautifully captures the bittersweet tragedy of Link's journey. Ultimately, it is an ode to childhood—a timeless love letter that preserves the magic and wonder of the 1998 adventure, proving once again that this legendary quest is undeniably timeless.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
